description: This source file provides a concrete implementation of the CalendarRepository interface, handling calendar events, leaves, and astrology details by interacting with DAOs and the database. It includes methods for CRUD operations and mapping between database entities and domain models.

classes.name: CalendarRepositoryImpl
classes.description: A class implementing CalendarRepository interface, managing calendar events, leaves, and astrology data via DAOs.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events for a specific month and year, returning a flow of events mapped to domain models.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event to the database.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event in the database.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event from the database.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves all leave records as a flow of domain models.

methods.name: addLeave
methods.description: Inserts a new leave record into the database.

methods.name: getAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details for a specific date, as a flow.

methods.name: updateAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Updates existing astrology information in the database.
